SELECT avg(try_cast(length_of_stay AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges WHERE discharge_year = '2016'
Which Florida cities recorded the most fatal crashes in 2022?
SELECT cityname, count(*) AS crashes FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE statename = 'Florida' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many CRS reports in the library mention China in their titles?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_oversight.oversight_reports WHERE source = 'CRS' AND lower(title) LIKE '%china%'
Which states have the most units in subsidized housing projects?
SELECT substr(states, 4) AS state, sum(try_cast(total_units AS double)) AS units FROM govblock_housing.hud_psh_project WHERE try_cast(total_units AS double) > 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Were private-sector weekly wages higher in Manhattan or San Francisco in the third quarter of 2023?
Jobs and Wages by County and Industry

SELECT CASE area_fips WHEN '36061' THEN 'Manhattan' ELSE 'San Francisco' END AS county, try_cast(avg_wkly_wage AS double) AS weekly_wage FROM govblock_labor.qcew_quarterly WHERE area_fips IN ('36061', '06075') AND own_code = '5' AND industry_code = '10' AND year = '2023' AND qtr = '3'
Which counties are home to the most people aged 85 and over?
SELECT ctyname, stname, try_cast(age85plus_tot AS double) AS aged_85_plus FROM govblock_census.popest_cc_est_agesex WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '7' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the average in-state tuition and fees at public colleges that mainly award bachelor's degrees?
SELECT avg(try_cast(tuitionfee_in AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_education.scorecard_most_recent_institution WHERE cast(control AS varchar) = '1' AND cast(preddeg AS varchar) = '3'
Which utility territories have the most recorded solar installations?

SELECT utility_service_territory, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_energy.oedi_tracking_the_sun WHERE utility_service_territory <> '-1' AND utility_service_territory IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many materials does the Materials Project rate as thermodynamically stable?
SELECT count(*) AS stable FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary WHERE cast(is_stable AS varchar) = 'true'
Under which approval pathways are listed drugs marketed?
SELECT marketing_category, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.fda_drug_ndc WHERE marketing_category IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the number of single audits filed change from 2017 to 2024?
SELECT audit_year AS year, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_executive.fac_general WHERE audit_year IN ('2017', '2024') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which medical specialties write the most Medicare prescriptions for insulin glargine?
Medicare Part D Prescribers By Provider And Drug

SELECT prscrbr_type, sum(try_cast(tot_clms AS double)) AS claims FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_provider_and_drug WHERE gnrc_name LIKE 'Insulin Glargine%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many wrecks and underwater obstructions does the PR100 study map around Puerto Rico?
Which congressional districts reach into the most counties?

SELECT s.usps || '-' || substr(r.geoid_cd119_20, 3, 2) AS district, count(DISTINCT r.geoid_county_20) AS counties FROM govblock_census.rel2020_tab20_cd11920_county20 r JOIN govblock_census.gazetteer_gaz_state s ON s.geoid = substr(r.geoid_cd119_20, 1, 2) WHERE try_cast(r.arealand_part AS double) > 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What number of compounds in ChEMBL have a molecular weight above 500?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_compound_properties WHERE mw_freebase > 500
Which states have the most natural gas combined-cycle capacity?

SELECT state, round(sum(mw)) AS gas_cc_mw FROM (SELECT state, plant_code, generator_id, max(try_cast(nameplate_capacity_mw AS double)) AS mw FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_operable WHERE technology LIKE 'Natural Gas Fired Combined Cycle%' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
By how much did overall consumer prices rise in 2022 compared with 2021?

SELECT round(100 * (max(CASE WHEN cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' THEN try_cast(value AS double) END) / max(CASE WHEN cast(year AS varchar) = '2021' THEN try_cast(value AS double) END) - 1), 1) AS pct_change FROM govblock_labor.bls_cu_data WHERE series_id = 'CUUR0000SA0' AND period = 'M13'
Which offices appeared on the most ballots in North Carolina in 2020?

SELECT office, count(DISTINCT precinct) AS precincts FROM govblock_elections.medsl_precinct_returns WHERE state = 'NORTH CAROLINA' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2020' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many formal water enforcement settlements were entered each year from 2015 to 2024?

SELECT substr(settlement_entered_date, 7, 4) AS year, count(*) AS settlements FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_formal_enforcement_actions WHERE substr(settlement_entered_date, 7, 4) BETWEEN '2015' AND '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which subsidized housing projects in California are the largest?
SELECT name, program_label, try_cast(total_units AS double) AS units FROM govblock_housing.hud_psh_project WHERE states = 'CA California' ORDER BY 3 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
What share of PubChem substances were taken from patents through PATENTSCOPE?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN c1 = 'PATENTSCOPE (WIPO)' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_substance_sid_map
Which EPA divisions bring the most enforcement cases?
SELECT hq_division, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_case_enforcements WHERE hq_division IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many reactions come from patent applications published in 2015?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.uspto_reactions_applications WHERE year = '2015'
Which kinds of Clean Water Act permit violations have drawn the most enforcement actions?
SELECT violation_desc, count(*) AS actions FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_violation_enforcements GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many generating units reporting to EPA in 2023 began commercial operation after 2010?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.campd_facility_attributes WHERE year = 2023 AND try_cast(substr(cast(commercial_operation_date AS varchar), 1, 4) AS integer) > 2010
Which states produced the most wind power in 2024?

SELECT substr(series_id, 14, 2) AS state, try_cast(value AS double) AS thousand_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id LIKE 'ELEC.GEN.WND-%-99.A' AND length(series_id) = 20 AND substr(series_id, 14, 2) <> 'US' AND period = '2024' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many census-designated places, unincorporated communities, does the Census Bureau define?
SELECT count(DISTINCT geoid) AS cdps FROM govblock_census.gazetteer_gaz_place WHERE name LIKE '% CDP'
Which U.S. cities had the most residents in 2025?
SELECT name, stname, try_cast(popestimate2025 AS double) AS population FROM govblock_census.popest_sub_est WHERE cast(sumlev AS varchar) = '162' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many meals did drug and device companies buy for doctors in 2019?
SELECT count(*) AS payments FROM govblock_health.op_general WHERE nature_of_payment_or_transfer_of_value = 'Food and Beverage' AND cast(program_year AS varchar) = '2019'
Which states have the largest legislatures?
SELECT upper(substr(state_file, 1, 2)) AS state, count(*) AS members FROM govblock_geo.legislature_members GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many federal award recipients are based outside the United States?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_recipient_lookup WHERE country_code <> 'USA'
Which states have the largest number of public schools?
SELECT statename, count(*) AS schools FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_029 WHERE school_year = '2023-2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many contract opportunities did the Department of Veterans Affairs post for work in New York in 2025?
SELECT count(*) AS notices FROM govblock_awards.sam_opportunities WHERE departmentindagency LIKE 'VETERANS AFFAIRS%' AND popstate = 'NY' AND posteddate LIKE '2025%'
Which states had the highest average annual pay in 2023?
Jobs and Wages by County and Industry

SELECT t.area_title, try_cast(q.avg_annual_pay AS double) AS avg_pay FROM govblock_labor.qcew_annual AS q JOIN govblock_labor.qcew_area_titles AS t ON t.area_fips = q.area_fips WHERE q.agglvl_code = '50' AND q.own_code = '0' AND q.year = '2023' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
Do companies pay doctors more in cash or in kind? (2023)

SELECT form_of_payment_or_transfer_of_value, sum(try_cast(total_amount_of_payment_usdollars AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_health.op_general WHERE cast(program_year AS varchar) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What kinds of Medicare Advantage plan are most common?
Ma Enrollment By Contract Plan State County
SELECT plan_type, count(DISTINCT concat(contract_id, '-', plan_id)) AS plans FROM govblock_health.ma_enrollment_by_contract_plan_state_county GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many applications in the examination file went on to issue as patents?
SELECT count(*) AS granted FROM govblock_patents.patex_application_data_25 WHERE patent_number <> ''
Which congressional candidates spent the most in the 2010 cycle?
SELECT can_nam, sum(try_cast(dis_amo AS double)) AS spent FROM govblock_fec.candidate_disbursement WHERE ele_yea = '2010' AND can_nam IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What did a vaginal delivery cost on average in New York hospital charges in 2016?
SELECT avg(try_cast(total_charges AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges WHERE discharge_year = '2016' AND apr_drg_description LIKE 'Vaginal delivery%'
Which federal information collections cost the government the most each year?
SELECT title, try_cast(annualfederalcostamount AS double) AS annual_cost FROM govblock_executive.oira_pra_inventory ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Did Democratic or Republican House candidates win more votes nationwide in 2022?

SELECT party, sum(try_cast(candidatevotes AS double)) AS votes FROM govblock_elections.medsl_house_returns WHERE stage = 'GEN' AND year = '2022' AND party IN ('DEMOCRAT', 'REPUBLICAN') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
Which natural gas storage fields hold the most working gas?
SELECT name, try_cast(workcap AS double) AS working_gas_mcf FROM govblock_siting.hifld_natural_gas_storage_facilities WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
